[`vmsvga_fifo_run()`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/qemu-project-qemu@300438ffbb8d9430cac2fcc15cba6f482b2c0587/-/blob/hw/display/vmware_vga.c?L616-L798) — the central SVGA command dispatch loop.

Two changes:

2. **`while (args-- > 0)`** at L783: fixes undefined behavior when `args == 0` with the previous `while (args--)` (signed underflow path was unreachable here, but the `> 0` guard is a correctness improvement; **precise read-based observation**).
